snippet.title: Below | Found Footage Egyptian Horror With Outlast Chases | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get BELOW on Steam now (20% Launch Discount): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043280/Below/

Below is a VHS-style found footage horror game set deep under the Great Pyramids of Egypt. If you’re burnt out on the endless wave of ghost and haunted house games and want the pure adrenaline of Outlast-style chases, I built this to switch things up.

You play as Alex Levine, a freelance reporter who went missing. You're not fighting, and you're not hiding. You are just running for your life from mummies and the manifestations of Anubis. It’s raw, it’s VHS-styled, and it’s focused entirely on high-speed survival.

As a solo developer, I spent 13 months building this, focusing heavily on optimizing performance without sacrificing photorealistic visuals to capture that feeling of being hunted.

Tell me in the comments: if you were Alex, would you go down there for the story of a lifetime, or would you stay away?
